scope: v0.26.5 RC6 attempt 37 supersedes failed RC5 attempt 36. RC5 was correctly blocked before artifact upload by a StrictMode bug in the staged manual-Recomps candidate test; the direct-library runtime itself had already passed the complete source suite. RC6 preserves the exact direct Recomps runtime from production source e2889ebd037b9fea0c4a47b525ad11041f9bcf9a and fixes/strengthens the packaged candidate gate. Recomps is a simple persistent native EXE library, not a generic provider/store/emulator surface. Selecting the Recomps tile from Games must route directly to RecompsLibrary and must never expose PlatformChoice, ProviderStore, PlatformHome, PlatformShelf, PlatformLibrary, Home/Shelf/Library/Install & Manage, provider management rails, root-folder controls, refresh/scanning semantics, storefront installation actions, or emulator routing. RecompsLibrary must expose Add Recomp Game, Back to Platforms and all saved RecompGames. Add Recomp Game must show .exe files only, select exactly one executable, append one persistent game record without replacing existing entries, reject duplicate exact paths and return directly to RecompsLibrary. Each saved game opens RecompsGame with Launch when its executable exists, Open Folder, Remove from Recomps and Back only. Launch must call the exact saved LaunchTarget directly through Start-ExternalProcess. Remove must remove only that Console record plus stale recent/favorite references, never delete or alter the executable/game files, and return to RecompsLibrary. Back from RecompsGame returns to RecompsLibrary; Back from RecompsLibrary returns to the platform shelf. Stale old-build Recomps navigation state including PlatformChoice, ProviderStore, PlatformHome, PlatformShelf, PlatformLibrary and ProviderGame must normalize to the simple Recomps pages so the screenshot behavior cannot return. The final Recomps owner must load after V7 and wrap the actual post-V7 Render-GamesHub, Invoke-Action, Handle-Back, Get-PageDefinition, picker and confirmation owners. Preserve RecompGames native config persistence, bootstrap/installer payload inclusion and the absence of folder scanning/guessing. The staged manual Recomps candidate test must treat source needles literally under StrictMode and must behaviorally execute the packaged HuymaierRecompsFinal.ps1 in a headless Games environment, proving direct tile-to-library routing, stale PlatformChoice/ProviderStore normalization, Install & Manage suppression, exact-EXE picker return, RecompsGame navigation, remove-without-delete and the stagedManualRecompsBehavioralRoutingGate. Preserve all validated RC3/RC4 rendering and platform fixes: HC3D v2 mirrored winding, D3D11 back-face/double-sided handling, authored UV/sampler orientation, full-screen viewer UV orientation, shared model brightness, PS4/Sega CD/NES/SNES canonical naming, Xbox PC versus Original Xbox isolation, V7 native D3D11 shelves, frozen emulator console selection and frozen PS1/PS2/PS3 behavior. Preserve unified native cursor, streaming, GameCube, Download Refresh/history, provider concurrency, artwork persistence, installer rollback/tamper handling, Steam ownership, Game Bar and external foreground app behavior. Production source e2889ebd037b9fea0c4a47b525ad11041f9bcf9a is green on the same exact commit across Platform Models, Unified Cursor, Performance, Download Refresh and GameCube, and a separate release-transformed mini-stage passed the exact packaged manual-Recomps candidate gate. Upload only if the candidate request parent exactly equals production_source, exact-source revalidation passes, the x64 FSE host and release-shaped package build pass, installer/integrity fault injection passes, stabilization and staged cursor/streaming/GameCube/V7 pass, the staged behavioral manual-Recomps gate passes, active-download and Steam-owned-library tests pass, and final SHA verification succeeds.
